_comment: 題庫。zh 句子的 pinyin 逐字對齊（空格分隔、含調號），用於顯示提示；en 的 focus 說明練習重點。

en.text: The cat sat on the mat.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
I would like a glass of water, please.
Could you please pass me the red pencil?
The weather is really wonderful today.
Three green trees grow in the garden.
She sells seashells by the seashore.
Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.

zh.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān chī píng guǒ
niú ròu miàn zhēn hǎo chī

zh.text: 今天天氣很好，我們去公園玩。
zh.pinyin: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo, wǒ men qù gōng yuán wán

zh.text: 老師說我們要努力學習。
zh.pinyin: lǎo shī shuō wǒ men yào nǔ lì xué xí
wǒ xū yào yì bēi bīng shuǐ

zh.text: 小兔子乖乖，把門兒開開。
zh.pinyin: xiǎo tù zi guāi guai, bǎ ménr kāi kai
lán lán de tiān kōng bái bái de yún

zh.text: 四是四，十是十，十四是十四。
zh.pinyin: sì shì sì, shí shì shí, shí sì shì shí sì

zh.text: 十二點半在圖書館見面。
zh.pinyin: shí èr diǎn bàn zài tú shū guǎn jiàn miàn

zh.text: 媽媽騎馬，馬慢，媽媽罵馬。
zh.pinyin: mā ma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, mā ma mà mǎ
